newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stable, short-term swaps firmer.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stable, short-term swaps firmer.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in slow late trading on Friday, with short-term swaps firming on tight liquidity, dealers said.
They said trading was driven by liquidity. A tighter rupiah market drove short-term swaps slightly higher but forwards were little changed although the Thai market remained in turmoil.
One European bank dealer said spot rates were trapped in a two-point range between 2,430 and 2,432 levels.
"Sentiment is a bit mixed. People seem to be waiting to see how the Thai market proceeds," the dealer said.
Spot rupiah was at 2,430.6/30.9 at 0930 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,430.5/31.5. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,430.25/29.75 and 2,429.25/29.75, respectively.
Overnight rupiah rose to 17 percent before settling at 15.0 percent on the back of higher tax payments. Overnight swap was at 1.5/1.7 points. Tom/next was at 0.35/0.40 points.
Spot/next was at 0.34/0.38. Dealers said longer-term rates were little affected although political and economic uncertainties in Thailand continued.
One-month swaps were at 13.75/14.75, two at 28.5/30.5, three at 43.5/44.5 and six at 83.0/84.5 points.
The central bank raised its intervention band by one point to 2,424/2,616 and its conversion band also by one point to 2,424/2,472 on Friday.
